fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: A child's early experiences at the dentist can shape how they feel about dental care for years to come. At Precision Dental, we make children's visits relaxed, positive and fun wherever possible, while providing careful preventive care that supports healthy teeth as they grow.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: We also partner with parents and carers, sharing practical advice that helps build healthy habits at home.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Is Children's Dentistry?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Children's dentistry focuses on the oral health needs of infants, children and teenagers. It places a strong emphasis on prevention and education, along with early detection and gentle treatment of concerns such as decay.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Tooth decay remains one of the most common chronic health conditions affecting Australian children, yet it is largely preventable. Regular visits, good home care and a tooth-friendly diet all make a difference.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Is Children's Dentistry Right for Your Child?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We recommend bringing your child for their first dental visit around their first birthday, or when their first teeth appear. Early visits allow children to become familiar with the dental environment before any problems arise.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Regular visits are important for all children, and particularly those who:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Have visible white spots, brown marks or holes in their teeth

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Snack frequently or drink juice or milk from a bottle at night

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Have had dental decay before

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Play sport and may need a mouthguard

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Have teeth that appear crowded or misaligned

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Feel anxious about dental visits

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Families who are eligible for the Child Dental Benefits Schedule are welcome, and our team can help check your child's eligibility.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Happens at Your Appointment

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: A Friendly Welcome

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We keep things calm and unhurried. Younger children can sit on a parent's lap for their first visit, and we explain each step in simple, reassuring language.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Examination

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We gently check your child's teeth, gums and bite, look for early signs of decay and monitor how teeth are developing. X-rays are taken only when needed.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Preventive Care

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Depending on your child's needs, we may clean their teeth, apply fluoride varnish to strengthen enamel or place fissure sealants to protect the deep grooves of back teeth.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Tips for Home

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We show your child, and you, how to brush effectively, and share advice about diet, drinks and dummy or thumb-sucking habits.

sections.label: Preparing Your Child for Their Visit

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Preparing Your Child for Their Visit

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Book morning appointments or times outside nap schedules for younger children. Avoid words such as needle or pain, and try reading a picture book about visiting the dentist together. If your child has additional needs, please let us know beforehand so we can plan the visit around them.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Aftercare and Ongoing Care

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Help children brush twice a day with a children's fluoride toothpaste until they can brush well on their own, usually around age eight. Offer water between meals, limit sugary snacks and avoid putting children to bed with a bottle of milk or juice. Book regular check-ups as recommended.

sections.label: Why Choose Precision Dental for Children's Dentistry

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Why Choose Precision Dental for Children's Dentistry

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Our team takes a warm, patient approach with children and never rushes a nervous child. A ceiling-mounted television offers a welcome distraction, and our oral health therapist provides preventive care in a relaxed, family-friendly way. We also see children for urgent care, including children's dental emergencies.

sections.label: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The cost of your treatment depends on your individual needs. After your examination, we talk you through your options and the expected fees before any treatment begins. We accept most major health funds, process claims on the spot through HICAPS and are a preferred provider for {{site:preferredFunds}}. Payment plans are available through DentiCare for eligible patients, subject to terms and conditions. You can learn more on our Prices and Payment Options page.

fields.label: Small label
fields.value: FAQ

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Frequently Asked Questions

fields.label: Question
fields.value: When should my child first see the dentist?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We recommend a first visit around 12 months of age or when the first teeth appear, whichever comes first.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Are baby teeth important if they fall out anyway?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Yes. Baby teeth help children chew, speak and hold space for adult teeth. Decay in baby teeth can cause pain and infection.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: What are fissure sealants?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Fissure sealants are thin protective coatings placed into the grooves of back teeth to help prevent food and bacteria from collecting there.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: My child is nervous. How can you help?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We take things slowly, explain each step and let your child get comfortable before we begin. You are welcome to stay with your child throughout the appointment.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: How can I tell if my child has tooth decay?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Early decay can appear as chalky white spots or brown areas. Other signs include sensitivity, pain or avoiding certain foods. Regular check-ups help detect decay early.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Is my child eligible for the Child Dental Benefits Schedule?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Eligibility depends on your child's age and whether your family receives certain government payments. Our team can help you check before your visit.
